segments.name: Lidar sensor kits
segments.description: Ouster sells and produces digital lidar sensor kits and related sensing and perception hardware to industrial, smart infrastructure, robotics and automotive customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable and operating segment, which relates to the sale and production of lidar sensor kits.

revenueModel.text: Customers and distributors pay for lidar sensor product sales, with additional revenue from software development services and IP royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Company's revenue comes from product sales of lidar sensors to direct customers and distributors.
